digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store mounting
propositions: rebar init silently creates an empty orphan branch when a fetch fails or times out, making an existing remote branch appear as a genuine first init
the current ref-only check in _mount_or_create_branch and pending_init_attaches_to_existing cannot distinguish between a reachable remote that lacks the branch and an unreachable remote
when fetch fails or the remote is unreachable, init must fail closed with a distinct diagnostic and never create an orphan unless --force-new-store is explicitly supplied

a shared tri-state remote probe using git ls-remote must differentiate advertised (return 0), reachable-absent (return 2), and unreachable/timeout (return 124) states, cached per repo/remote/branch for one CLI invocation
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount and return without error, allowing the strict path to reuse the cached result and report the actionable failure
